title: Risk-Averse Stochastic User Equilibrium on Uncertain Transportation Networks
summary: Travel times in transportation networks are uncertain and exhibit right-skewed distributions with long tails under weather and incident disruptions. The current challenge is that expected cost traffic assignment underestimates rare but severe delays, while path-based logit stochastic user equilibrium (SUE) models assign positive flow to every prespecified route, and estimated scenario probabilities may be misspecified.
